metadata.description:
A 4-step filtering workflow where a user progressively refines their
funding call search by specifying various preferences. Tests the system's
ability to accumulate user preferences (funding model exclusion, funding
rate, deadline range, partner requirements) and apply these as filters
to narrow down search results. The final list should reflect all
accumulated preferences.
